/**
 * @file
 * @brief ztest assertion macros
 *
 * This header contains the various assertion macros for ztest.
 */

#ifndef ZEPHYR_SUBSYS_TESTSUITE_ZTEST_INCLUDE_ZTEST_ASSERT_H_
#define ZEPHYR_SUBSYS_TESTSUITE_ZTEST_INCLUDE_ZTEST_ASSERT_H_

#include <zephyr/ztest.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <math.h> /* For floating point assertions like zassert_almost_equal */

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

/**
 * @brief Fail the current test.
 *
 * @param msg The message to print.
 * @param ... Optional arguments for the message.
 */
void ztest_test_fail(const char *msg, ...);

/**
 * @brief Pass the current test.
 *
 * @param msg The message to print.
 * @param ... Optional arguments for the message.
 */
void ztest_test_pass(const char *msg, ...);

/**
 * @brief Assert that a condition is true.
 *
 * @param cond The condition to check.
 * @param msg The message to print if the condition is false.
 * @param ... Optional arguments for the message.
 */
#define zassert_true(cond, msg, ...) \
	do { \
		if (!(cond)) { \
			ztest_test_fail(msg, ##__VA_ARGS__); \
		} \
	} while (0)

/**
 * @brief Assert that a condition is false.
 *
 * @param cond The condition to check.
 * @param msg The message to print if the condition is true.
 * @param ... Optional arguments for the message.
 */
#define zassert_false(cond, msg, ...) \
	do { \
		if (cond) { \
			ztest_test_fail(msg, ##__VA_ARGS__); \
		} \
	} while (0)

/**
 * @brief Assert that two values are equal.
 *
 * @param a The first value.
 * @param b The second value.
 * @param msg The message to print if the values are not equal.
 * @param ... Optional arguments for the message.
 */
#define zassert_equal(a, b, msg, ...) \
	do { \
		if ((a) != (b)) { \
			ztest_test_fail(msg, ##__VA_ARGS__); \
		} \
	} while (0)

/**
 * @brief Assert that two values are not equal.
 *
 * @param a The first value.
 * @param b The second value.
 * @param msg The message to print if the values are equal.
 * @param ... Optional arguments for the message.
 */
#define zassert_not_equal(a, b, msg, ...) \
	do { \
		if ((a) == (b)) { \
			ztest_test_fail(msg, ##__VA_ARGS__); \
		} \
	} while (0)

/**
 * @brief Assert that two pointers are equal.
 *
 * @param a The first pointer.
 * @param b The second pointer.
 * @param msg The message to print if the pointers are not equal.
 * @param ... Optional arguments for the message.
 */
#define zassert_equal_ptr(a, b, msg, ...) \
	do { \
		if ((a) != (b)) { \
			ztest_test_fail(msg, ##__VA_ARGS__); \
		} \
	} while (0)

/**
 * @brief Assert that two pointers are not equal.
 *
 * @param a The first pointer.
 * @param b The second pointer.
 * @param msg The message to print if the pointers are equal.
 * @param ... Optional arguments for the message.
 */
#define zassert_not_equal_ptr(a, b, msg, ...) \
	do { \
		if ((a) == (b)) { \
			ztest_test_fail(msg, ##__VA_ARGS__); \
		} \
	} while (0)

/**
 * @brief Assert that a pointer is NULL.
 *
 * @param ptr The pointer to check.
 * @param msg The message to print if the pointer is not NULL.
 * @param ... Optional arguments for the message.
 */
#define zassert_is_null(ptr, msg, ...) \
	do { \
		if ((ptr) != NULL) { \
			ztest_test_fail(msg, ##__VA_ARGS__); \
		} \
	} while (0)

/**
 * @brief Assert that a pointer is not NULL.
 *
 * @param ptr The pointer to check.
 * @param msg The message to print if the pointer is NULL.
 * @param ... Optional arguments for the message.
 */
#define zassert_not_null(ptr, msg, ...) \
	do { \
		if ((ptr) == NULL) { \
			ztest_test_fail(msg, ##__VA_ARGS__); \
		} \
	} while (0)

/**
 * @brief Assert that a return code is OK (0).
 *
 * @param rc The return code to check.
 * @param msg The message to print if the return code is not OK.
 * @param ... Optional arguments for the message.
 */
#define zassert_ok(rc, msg, ...) \
	do { \
		if ((rc) != 0) { \
			ztest_test_fail(msg, ##__VA_ARGS__); \
		} \
	} while (0)

/**
 * @brief Assert that a return code is not OK (0).
 *
 * @param rc The return code to check.
 * @param msg The message to print if the return code is OK.
 * @param ... Optional arguments for the message.
 */
#define zassert_not_ok(rc, msg, ...) \
	do { \
		if ((rc) == 0) { \
			ztest_test_fail(msg, ##__VA_ARGS__); \
		} \
	} while (0)

/**
 * @brief Assert that two memory blocks are equal.
 *
 * @param expected The expected memory block.
 * @param actual The actual memory block.
 * @param size The size of the memory blocks.
 * @param msg The message to print if the memory blocks are not equal.
 * @param ... Optional arguments for the message.
 */
#define zassert_mem_equal(expected, actual, size, msg, ...) \
	do { \
		if (memcmp(expected, actual, size) != 0) { \
			ztest_test_fail(msg, ##__VA_ARGS__); \
		} \
	} while (0)

/**
 * @brief Assert that two memory blocks are not equal.
 *
 * @param expected The expected memory block.
 * @param actual The actual memory block.
 * @param size The size of the memory blocks.
 * @param msg The message to print if the memory blocks are equal.
 * @param ... Optional arguments for the message.
 */
#define zassert_mem_not_equal(expected, actual, size, msg, ...) \
	do { \
		if (memcmp(expected, actual, size) == 0) { \
			ztest_test_fail(msg, ##__VA_ARGS__); \
		} \
	} while (0)

/**
 * @brief Assert that a value is within a range (inclusive).
 *
 * @param val The value to check.
 * @param ref The reference value.
 * @param delta The allowed deviation from the reference.
 * @param msg The message to print if the value is outside the range.
 * @param ... Optional arguments for the message.
 */
#define zassert_within_delta(val, ref, delta, msg, ...) \
	do { \
		if (!(((val) >= ((ref) - (delta))) && ((val) <= ((ref) + (delta))))) { \
			ztest_test_fail(msg, ##__VA_ARGS__); \
		} \
	} while (0)

/**
 * @brief Assert that a value is greater than another.
 *
 * @param val The value to check.
 * @param ref The reference value.
 * @param msg The message to print if the value is not greater than the reference.
 * @param ... Optional arguments for the message.
 */
#define zassert_greater(val, ref, msg, ...) \
	do { \
		if (!((val) > (ref))) { \
			ztest_test_fail(msg, ##__VA_ARGS__); \
		} \
	} while (0)

/**
 * @brief Assert that a value is greater than or equal to another.
 *
 * @param val The value to check.
 * @param ref The reference value.
 * @param msg The message to print if the value is not greater than or equal to the reference.
 * @param ... Optional arguments for the message.
 */
#define zassert_greater_equal(val, ref, msg, ...) \
	do { \
		if (!((val) >= (ref))) { \
			ztest_test_fail(msg, ##__VA_VA_ARGS__); \
		} \
	} while (0)

/**
 * @brief Assert that a value is less than another.
 *
 * @param val The value to check.
 * @param ref The reference value.
 * @param msg The message to print if the value is not less than the reference.
 * @param ... Optional arguments for the message.
 */
#define zassert_less(val, ref, msg, ...) \
	do { \
		if (!((val) < (ref))) { \
			ztest_test_fail(msg, ##__VA_ARGS__); \
		} \
	} while (0)

/**
 * @brief Assert that a value is less than or equal to another.
 *
 * @param val The value to check.
 * @param ref The reference value.
 * @param msg The message to print if the value is not less than or equal to the reference.
 * @param ... Optional arguments for the message.
 */
#define zassert_less_equal(val, ref, msg, ...) \
	do { \
		if (!((val) <= (ref))) { \
			ztest_test_fail(msg, ##__VA_ARGS__); \
		} \
	} while (0)

/**
 * @brief Assert that two float values are equal.
 *
 * @param a The first float value.
 * @param b The second float value.
 * @param msg The message to print if the values are not equal.
 * @param ... Optional arguments for the message.
 */
#define zassert_equal_float(a, b, msg, ...) \
	do { \
		if ((a) != (b)) { \
			ztest_test_fail(msg, ##__VA_ARGS__); \
		} \
	} while (0)

/**
 * @brief Assert that two float values are not equal.
 *
 * @param a The first float value.
 * @param b The second float value.
 * @param msg The message to print if the values are equal.
 * @param ... Optional arguments for the message.
 */
#define zassert_not_equal_float(a, b, msg, ...) \
	do { \
		if ((a) == (b)) { \
			ztest_test_fail(msg, ##__VA_ARGS__); \
		} \
	} while (0)

/**
 * @brief Assert that two double values are equal.
 *
 * @param a The first double value.
 * @param b The second double value.
 * @param msg The message to print if the values are not equal.
 * @param ... Optional arguments for the message.
 */
#define zassert_equal_double(a, b, msg, ...) \
	do { \
		if ((a) != (b)) { \
			ztest_test_fail(msg, ##__VA_ARGS__); \
		} \
	} while (0)

/**
 * @brief Assert that two double values are not equal.
 *
 * @param a The first double value.
 * @param b The second double value.
 * @param msg The message to print if the values are equal.
 * @param ... Optional arguments for the message.
 */
#define zassert_not_equal_double(a, b, msg, ...) \
	do { \
		if ((a) == (b)) { \
			ztest_test_fail(msg, ##__VA_ARGS__); \
		} \
	} while (0)

/**
 * @brief Assert that two floating point values are almost equal within a delta.
 *
 * @param a The first floating point value.
 * @param b The second floating point value.
 * @param delta The maximum allowed difference between a and b.
 * @param msg The message to print if the values are not almost equal.
 * @param ... Optional arguments for the message.
 */
#define zassert_almost_equal(a, b, delta, msg, ...) \
	do { \
		if (fabs((double)(a) - (double)(b)) > (double)(delta)) { \
			ztest_test_fail(msg, ##__VA_ARGS__); \
		} \
	} while (0)

/**
 * @brief Indicate that a code path should not be reached.
 *
 * @param msg The message to print.
 * @param ... Optional arguments for the message.
 */
#define zassert_unreachable(msg, ...) \
	do { \
		ztest_test_fail(msg, ##__VA_ARGS__); \
	} while (0)

/**
 * @brief Indicate that a panic condition has occurred.
 *
 * @param msg The message to print.
 * @param ... Optional arguments for the message.
 */
#define zassert_panic(msg, ...) \
	do { \
		ztest_test_fail(msg, ##__VA_ARGS__); \
	} while (0)

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif

#endif /* ZEPHYR_SUBSYS_TESTSUITE_ZTEST_INCLUDE_ZTEST_ASSERT_H_ */
